card.title: Protection Has Terms
card.instruction: Treat safety, support, and reassurance as arrangements that require you to remain in control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my car. I'll feel better if we agree every stop first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Text before leaving hers so I can approve the traffic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She might need me to stay overnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Give me her number; I'll arrange your bedtime so you're safe to drive.
